recognize_zh: 視野中央有一團邊界模糊的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），核細長呈拖鞋狀、細胞質淡粉紅且界線不清，周圍被小淋巴球與漿細胞圍繞，即為肉芽腫。此視野未見乾酪樣壞死或多核巨細胞。
features: Loose, ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes in the center of the field
Epithelioid cells have elongated, slipper- or boomerang-shaped vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders, giving a syncytial appearance
Surrounding cuff of small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells
No caseous necrosis or multinucleated Langhans giant cells in this field
describe_en: H&E-stained tissue section shows a cellular background containing an ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes. At higher power, these cells have elongated, slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders, and they are cuffed by small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and culture are recommended, and in this case context an acid-fast stain supported tuberculosis.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are typically tight, well-formed, non-necrotizing and have scant lymphocytic cuffing, with negative special stains and cultures.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with epithelioid histiocyte-rich background (e.g. Hodgkin or lymphoepithelioid T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical large cells (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg or atypical T cells) among the histiocytes, confirmed by CD30/CD15 or T-cell immunohistochemistry.
Morphology is similar, so GMS or PAS stains showing yeast forms, rather than acid-fast bacilli, separate them.
Lipogranulomas contain fat vacuoles and drug-related granulomas are small and non-necrotizing with a supporting drug history.
